question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (c.birth_date IS NOT NULL) AND
    (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date) = '1999-09-25') AND
    (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-25') = '2026-09-25');

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND CAST(strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-24') AS TEXT) >= CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
  )
  OR (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 26
    AND CAST(strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-24') AS TEXT) < CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (
        CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
        AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09'
        AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = '26'
    )
    OR (
        CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 < 2026
        AND (
            CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
            < 926
        )
    )
    OR (
        CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 > 2026
        AND (
            CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
            > 926
        )
    );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) = 25
    AND (
        CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) AS TEXT) >= CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
        OR 
        (CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER))
    )
    AND (
        CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) AS TEXT) < CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
        OR 
        (CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) < CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER))
        OR
        (CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AND CAST(strftime('%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) < CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER))
    ) = FALSE;
